title: Shift Handover Protocol
content:
Shift Handover Protocol:

1. Timing
   - Day shift: 06:00 - 18:00
   - Night shift: 18:00 - 06:00
   - Handover period: 15 minutes before shift change
   - Shift supervisor must be on-site 30 minutes before shift start

2. Handover Checklist
   - Equipment status: all running equipment and any in breakdown
   - Production metrics: tonnes milled, grade, recovery for the shift
   - Safety issues: any incidents, near-misses, or hazards identified
   - Weather conditions: surface conditions affecting operations
   - Outstanding maintenance: any pending work orders
   - Personnel: any absenteeism or crew changes

3. Documentation
   - Digital shift log entry (mandatory, before leaving site)
   - Verbal briefing to incoming shift supervisor
   - Handover signature in shift book (physical backup)
   - Any pending actions highlighted with priority tags

4. Critical Handover Items
   - Active blasting operations in progress
   - Equipment lockout/tagout status
   - Gas monitoring readings (underground)
   - Water pumping status and dam levels
   - Environmental discharge compliance status

5. Escalation
   - Any unresolved safety issue must be escalated to Mine Manager before handover
   - Environmental exceedances must be communicated to Environmental Manager
   - Production shortfalls >10% of target reported to Plant Manager

title: Emergency Response Procedures
content:
Emergency Response Procedures:

1. Emergency Classification
   - Category 1 (Critical): Fatality, serious injury, major structural failure
   - Category 2 (Major): Fire, explosion, gas ingress, flooding
   - Category 3 (Serious): Equipment damage, environmental spill, near-miss
   - Category 4 (Minor): First aid, minor equipment damage

2. Immediate Response
   - Sound alarm: 3 short blasts (evacuation) or continuous (emergency)
   - Radio Channel 1: Emergency announcement with location and nature
   - Account for all personnel in affected area
   - Activate emergency response team

3. Communication Chain
   - Mine Manager -> Safety Manager -> Department Heads -> All supervisors
   - External: Emergency services (if required), DMRE (within 24 hours for Category 1)
   - Community notification if surface impact

4. Assembly Points
   - Underground: Nearest refuge chamber
   - Surface: Main parking area (south gate)
   - Processing: Assembly point B (east of plant)
   - Head office: Front reception

5. Post-Emergency
   - Incident investigation team deployed within 24 hours
   - Root cause analysis using 5-Why method
   - Corrective actions assigned with deadlines
   - Lessons learned communicated to all operations
   - Formal incident report to DMRE within required timeframe
